observation.command:
cd /workspace/project && curl -s --max-time 25 -A "Mozilla/5.0" "https://uplinkswitch.ai/guides" | python3 -c "
import sys,re,html
s=sys.stdin.read(); s=re.sub(r'<script.*?</script>','',s,flags=re.S); s=re.sub(r'<style.*?</style>','',s,flags=re.S)
t=html.unescape(re.sub(r'<[^>]+>',' ',s)); t=re.sub(r'\s+',' ',t)
for kw in ['free','credit','trial','minimum']:
    i=t.lower().find(kw)
    if i>0: print(f'[{kw}] …{t[max(0,i-90):i+140]}…')
print('---'); print(t[:400])
"
